 Islanders Gameday News: Line shuffling
 by Dominik Nov 7, 2026, 11:00 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The devil may come. Getty Images The Islanders host the Devils before heading out on their annual fall California trip. The Devils are on a heater and feature new want-away former Jet Connor Hellebuyck, so they’re feeling good.
 The Islanders are in a win-loss, win-loss mode, except now they’ve lost consecutive games in regulation for the first time this season. Another regulation loss tonight would create concern.
 First Islanders Goal picks go here .
 Islanders News
 Gross: It’s still early, but the Isles need to start collecting points. [ Newsday ] 
 Pete DeBoer shuffled lines again at practice, wit Ondrej Palat, top-sixer in 2026. Also: it feels like it might be Ben Hutton’s debut. [ Isles ] 
 Emil Heineman – Bo Horvat – Kyle Palmieri
Ondřej Palát – Brayden Schenn – Victor Eklund
Simon Holmström – JG Pageau – Anthony Duclair
Kyle MacLean – Casey Cizikas – Mitchell Chaffee
 The latest Weird Islanders goes a wee bit further back in time, like a full Leboff in time, with goalie Jeff Hackett. [ LHH ] 
 Elsewhere
 Hellebuyck cites “challenging circumstances” with family and Winnipeg for demanding a trade from the Jets. [ ESPN ] 
 Connor McDavid and the Oilers are really sensitive about Connor McDavid getting hit. [ Sportsnet | TSN ] 
 More interesting potential landing spots for Nikita Kucherov, except not. [ Sportsnet ] 
 The James Reimer Ranger Era did not last long. [ AP ] 
 Carey Price talks about Habs inspiration on his way to the Hall of Fame. [ NHL ]
